messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-style bicycle repair and tune-up learning game for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Deliver the game now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone and tablet play with usable touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px wide, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with a canvas-drawn pseudo-3D bicycle and interactive repair steps.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive workshop game UI with lessons, progress, tool selection, bike-part targets, repair feedback, and completion/replay flow.
- Added sequential lessons for fixing a flat, setting brakes, caring for the chain, and tuning gears.

### Active
- Validate the page in a browser; check for JavaScript errors, gameplay issues, and mobile layout defects.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game in a browser and test all repair steps, including the completion and replay flows.
2. Fix any issues found and save/read the latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; currently the only added game file.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- No browser validation or screenshot capture has been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable bicycle repair and tune-up learning game for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Deliver the game without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support usable touch controls on phones and tablets.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks at viewport widths of at most 1280px; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with a canvas-drawn pseudo-3D bicycle and interactive repair steps.
- Lessons cover fixing a flat, setting brakes, caring for the chain, and tuning gears.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the responsive workshop UI, bike scene, lesson progress, tool selection, repair feedback, and completion/replay flow in `index.html`.
- Added sequential interactive repair stages for all four lessons.

### Active
- Validate in a browser for JavaScript errors, gameplay issues, mobile layout defects, and completion/replay behavior.
- Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Start the game and open it in a browser.
2. Test each repair stage, completion, replay, and a mobile viewport; fix any issues found.
3. Save a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; currently the only game file.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- No browser validation or screenshot capture has been performed.
